apps.name: RF Monitor
apps.desc: Scrollable: RSSI/noise chart with dBm axis, link margin, RX rate, radio params, heard feed.

apps.name: Airtime
apps.desc: Utilization bars with a % axis, rx/tx split, duty ceiling, budget. Reset button top-right.

apps.name: Snake
apps.desc: The classic, in Lua. Swipe to steer.

apps.name: SDK Test
apps.desc: Developer tool. Checks the extended Lua SDK on this board: capabilities, clock, battery, GPS, file access, crypto against published RFC vectors, channel discovery, and buttons that TRANSMIT a test message to Public and a DM to your first contact (each asks permission first).
The classic sliding-tile puzzle. Swipe to move, tap to restart. Keeps your best score. Contributed by pisti87.

apps.name: Wardrive
apps.desc: LoRa coverage survey. Probes every 20s and logs each reply with GPS position, altitude and BOTH link directions (how well you heard them, how well they heard you) to a CSV. Reference app for wada.mesh.discover.

apps.name: Nearby
apps.desc: Your contacts on a real map, sorted by distance, with bearing and a live frame counter. Reference app for wada.map, wada.ui.list, wada.geo and app.on_packet.
